trace.final:
Done. Here's what happened:

1. **Checked deployment history** for checkout-api: v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in production; v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only in staging and also unhealthy).
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — completed successfully.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0002, on-call paged) titled "checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy," describing the failed health checks, the rollback to the last known-healthy version, and the successful rollout across all regions. (The first incident creation attempt timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key to guarantee exactly-once creation.)

No approval was needed since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production.
